topic: The Central Limit Theorem (CLT): The Magic of Bell Curves

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Concept of Distributions
lecture_lines: Data has a shape called a distribution.
Every outcome is equally likely here.
Many rolls form a uniform rectangle.
animations: Display text: 'Distributions describe data variability.' in #FFFFFF.
Show a histogram of a Normal distribution (#00FF00) fading in alongside the icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/dice.svg].
Highlight the peak of the distribution in #FF0000.

sections.title: The Problem: The Chaos of Small Samples
lecture_lines: Real-world data is rarely normal.
Most distributions are skewed or erratic.
Small samples lead to inconsistent predictions.
animations: Display text: 'Small samples capture noisy snapshots.' in #FFFFFF.
Show 3 small scatter point clusters (#00FFFF) appearing randomly with [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/camera.svg].

sections.title: The CLT Core Mechanism: The Power of Averages
lecture_lines: The CLT reveals a hidden pattern.
Sample means always approach a Bell Curve.
This holds regardless of population shape.
More samples make the curve clearer.
Averages magically form a symmetrical distribution.
animations: Display text: 'Averaging samples stabilizes erratic data.' in #FFFFFF.
Show multiple small [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/dice.svg] sample means animating towards the center (#FFFF00).
Transition into a single larger Normal distribution shape (#00FF00) represented by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/scales.svg].

sections.title: The 'Sample Size' Rule
lecture_lines: The magic number is thirty.
Sample size affects the curve's shape.
Larger samples reduce standard error.
The Bell Curve becomes more precise.
Precision increases with more data points.
animations: Display text: 'Bigger samples reveal the true shape.' in #FFFFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/magnifyingglass.svg]
Show a small N=5 distribution curve (#FF00FF).
Transition to a narrower, taller N=30 curve (#00FF00). [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/scale.svg]

sections.title: Real-World Application
lecture_lines: The CLT allows reliable population inferences.
We use small samples to estimate reality.
It guarantees accuracy in mass quality control.
Confidence intervals predict large-scale outcomes.
Statistics makes massive data manageable.
animations: Display text: 'Use CLT for reliable population estimates.' in #FFFFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/clipboard.svg]
Visualize a sample mean bar moving to a confidence range (#FFFF00).
Highlight the final result with a glowing border (#FFFFFF). [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/scanner.svg]
